A LITTLE CIRCLE TO MAKE YOUR OWN

Easy Bee Mandala Coloring Page

A happy bee floats in front of broad flower petals. Large honeycomb-inspired hexagons and rounded shapes form a simple circular frame for little color explorers.

  • Black & white line art
  • Large spaces for kids
  • Free personal & classroom use

Print your mandala

Print this mandala ↗

One drawing · A4 or Letter · Portrait
White margins and a smaller drawing help prevent cropped edges.

Inside this little mandala

The bee has two wings, a smiling face and a body divided into broad stripes. Large petals sit behind it. The outer circle alternates hexagons with paired rounded shapes, keeping the pattern spacious.

A coloring idea to try

Use the familiar yellow-and-black palette or invent a colorful bee. Repeat a single color in every hexagon and give the petals a different shade.

Make a little moment of it

Look for the six sides of a hexagon together. Children can practice a repeating color sequence in the outer ring without needing to copy a finished example.

Use pencils or crayons for the smaller sections. Print on paper suited to your materials, and put a protective sheet underneath if using markers. Printing is free for home and classroom use; please link to this page when sharing the design online.
